stamp.clock_model: native NClock domains; compare cycles only within a continuous timeline
stamp.boundary: machine-thread observation; no guest execution during capture

capture_cost_model: host wall duration through capture/render; excludes final envelope/file/transport

clock.model: native counters; no fixed CPU-speed conversion or host refresh inference

history.coverage: armed interval only; command boundaries, central records, IRQ edges, interrupt entry, EventTimer transitions and sampled native device fields

coverage.host_presentation: reference raster and source audio differ from actual GPU and host mix
coverage.source_semantics: Rosetta bound maps via guestview; variables/unwind/DWARF incomplete
coverage.replay: snapshots exclude clock/host state; no full replay

topology.coverage: core graph plus every compiled device ID; declared relations describe implementation structure, not a complete bus transaction or device dependency graph

irq.explanation: Controller combines source bits into the CPU IRQ line. CPU service tests the sampled IRQ/I pipeline; an asserted source alone does not prove handler entry. Multiple sources may be pending; no unique source is inferred.

schedule.coverage: three EventTimer queues; device-local timers, host queues and future software decisions are not all enumerated

devices.coverage: installed models plus independent debug-handler inventory; native fields are partial
